args.title: Make password reset email use the deployed site URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Currently, the password reset email uses a BASE_URL that defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not set in the environment, causing the reset link to point to localhost in deployed environments.

The suggested change is to ensure that PUBLIC_URL is properly set in deployments so that the correct base URL is used for email links, avoiding links that point to localhost, which do not work for users receiving reset emails.
